# BlockNote

> BlockNote is a React-based notion-style rich text editor, based on Prosemirror and Tiptap.

Important Notes:
 - It has an opinionated approach to building a rich text editor, and a much simpler API than either Tiptap or Prosemirror, so while it may be based on them, their APIs are not compatible and rarely exposed.
 - BlockNote uses it's own document model for reading, editing and saving documents. It is called BlockNote JSON and information can be found in the Document Structure page.

# Docs
    

## undefined

- [Introduction](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs.md): BlockNote is a block-based rich-text editor for React, focused on providing a great out-of-the-box experience with minimal setup.

- [Markdown](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/features/import/markdown.md): It's possible to import Markdown content into BlockNote blocks, completely client-side.

- [With Vanilla JS](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/getting-started/vanilla-js.md): BlockNote is mainly designed as a quick and easy drop-in block-based editor for React apps, but can also be used in vanilla JavaScript apps.

## react

- [Overview](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/react/overview.md): Learn how to use BlockNote With React
- [Adding DOM Attributes](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/react/styling-theming/adding-dom-attributes.md): BlockNote allows you to change how the editor UI looks. You can change the theme of the default UI, or override its CSS styles.
- [Styling & Theming](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/react/styling-theming.md): You can completely change the look and feel of the BlockNote editor. Change basic styling quickly with theme CSS variables, or apply more complex styles with additional CSS rules.
- [Overriding CSS](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/react/styling-theming/overriding-css.md): You can change any styles applied to the editor by setting your own CSS styles.
- [Themes](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/react/styling-theming/themes.md): Themes let you quickly change the basic look of the editor UI, including colors, borders, shadows, and font.
- [Formatting Toolbar](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/react/components/formatting-toolbar.md): The Formatting Toolbar appears whenever you highlight text in the editor.
- [Grid Suggestion Menus](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/react/components/grid-suggestion-menus.md): In addition to displaying Suggestion Menus as stacks, BlockNote also supports displaying them as grids.
- [Link Toolbar](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/react/components/hyperlink-toolbar.md): The Link Toolbar appears whenever you hover a link in the editor.
- [File Panel](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/react/components/image-toolbar.md): The File Panel appears whenever you select an image that doesn't have a URL, or when you click the "Replace File" button in the Formatting Panel when an image is selected.
- [UI Components](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/react/components.md): BlockNote includes a number of UI Components (like menus and toolbars) that can be completely customized.
- [Block Side Menu](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/react/components/side-menu.md): The Block Side Menu appears on the left side whenever you hover a block.
- [Suggestion Menus](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/react/components/suggestion-menus.md): Suggestion Menus appear when the user enters a trigger character, and text after the character is used to filter the menu items.

- [Manipulating Content](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/reference/editor/manipulating-content.md): How to read, create, update, and remove blocks and inline content in the BlockNote editor
- [Overview](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/reference/editor/overview.md): An overview of the BlockNote editor API.
- [Paste Handling](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/reference/editor/paste-handling.md): This section explains how to handle paste events in BlockNote.
- [YJS Utilities](https://www.blocknotejs.org/docs/reference/editor/yjs-utilities.md): Utilities for converting between BlockNote blocks and YJS collaborative documents
